name: How long does kitchen molding installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen molding installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen molding installation varies based on the kitchen's size, the complexity of the molding design, and the type of material chosen. A simple crown molding installation in an average-sized kitchen might take one to two days. More intricate designs, custom cuts, or installations involving multiple types of molding (e.g., crown, base, and shoe) could extend the project to three to five days. This estimate also includes preparation time, cutting, fitting, and finishing touches like caulking and painting. We provide a more precise timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen molding installation typically takes 1-5 days, depending on kitchen size, molding complexity, and materials.
